entries.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 INT4/INT8
flags: the card states a reconstruction gain of +4.2 to +8.7 dB [L113-114]; this is a quality-type number with no metric key, so it is not mapped
TTFT, prefill and decode tables [L138-253] are speed and latency only; the Verbatim column is not mapped
the 64 GB and 4 GB RAM figures [L138] are hardware, not sizes of this file
